options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

Definitions are copied from the v1 Metabase cards 180, 181 and 182 (exported 08-10-2026). Windows are fixed in the SQL (not the dashboard time picker) and months are UTC calendar months. A pilot counts as Australian-based as in v1: the fourth character from the end of the pilot's name is 'Y' (a home airport code starting with Y at the end of the name). 'Never flew' means no airborne time (groundspeed of 60 kt or more) on any flight in the period. v3 only sees pilots who filed a flight plan, because the flight gate needs a departure and an arrival. There is no backfill, so the monthly charts start at go-live and the latest month is incomplete.

panels.title: Pilots who logged on but never flew (90 days)
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 180. Pilots with a Y-suffixed name who completed at least one flight in the last 90 days, none with airborne time (v1: enroute time). Shows flights, their online minutes and totals. Most flights first, limited to 200 rows. Flights whose airborne time is unknown (raw positions already removed) are ignored. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table (see docs/t15_notes/a_pilots_people.md): one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
  WHERE airborne_minutes IS NOT NULL
),
pilot_enroute_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cid,
    name,
    COUNT(*) as total_flights,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN total_enroute_time_minutes > 0 THEN 1 END) as flights_with_enroute_time,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN total_enroute_time_minutes = 0 THEN 1 END) as flights_with_zero_enroute_time,
    AVG(time_online_minutes) as avg_time_online_minutes,
    MIN(time_online_minutes) as min_time_online_minutes,
    MAX(time_online_minutes) as max_time_online_minutes,
    SUM(time_online_minutes) as total_time_online_minutes
  FROM flight_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
  AND name IS NOT NULL
  AND completion_time IS NOT NULL
  AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY cid, name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT
  cid,
  name,
  total_flights,
  flights_with_zero_enroute_time,
  ROUND(flights_with_zero_enroute_time * 100.0 / total_flights, 2) as zero_enroute_percentage,
  ROUND(avg_time_online_minutes, 2) as avg_time_online_minutes,
  min_time_online_minutes,
  max_time_online_minutes,
  total_time_online_minutes
FROM pilot_enroute_stats
WHERE flights_with_enroute_time = 0
AND LENGTH(name) >= 4
AND SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, name
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Pilots who logged on in a month but never flew that month
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 181 (v1 drew a bar chart). Per UTC month of logon: pilots with a Y-suffixed name, and how many of them had no airborne time on any of their flights that month (bars), and that as a percentage (line, right axis). Flights are placed in the month of the session logon, as in v1. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table (see docs/t15_notes/a_pilots_people.md): one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
  WHERE airborne_minutes IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_pilot_stats AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
    cid,
    COUNT(*) as total_flights_in_month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN total_enroute_time_minutes > 0 THEN 1 END) as flights_with_enroute_time,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN total_enroute_time_minutes = 0 THEN 1 END) as flights_with_zero_enroute_time
  FROM flight_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
  AND completion_time IS NOT NULL
  AND logon_time IS NOT NULL
  AND name IS NOT NULL
  AND LENGTH(name) >= 4
  AND SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), cid
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),
monthly_zero_enroute_pilots AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as pilots_with_zero_enroute_time
  FROM monthly_pilot_stats
  WHERE flights_with_enroute_time = 0
  GROUP BY month
),
monthly_total_pilots AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as total_pilots
  FROM flight_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
  AND completion_time IS NOT NULL
  AND logon_time IS NOT NULL
  AND name IS NOT NULL
  AND LENGTH(name) >= 4
  AND SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
)
SELECT
  t.month,
  TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.month, 'FMMonth YYYY')) as month_label,
  t.total_pilots,
  COALESCE(z.pilots_with_zero_enroute_time, 0) as pilots_with_zero_enroute_time,
  ROUND(COALESCE(z.pilots_with_zero_enroute_time, 0) * 100.0 / t.total_pilots, 2) as percentage_zero_enroute
FROM monthly_total_pilots t
LEFT JOIN monthly_zero_enroute_pilots z ON t.month = z.month
ORDER BY t.month

panels.title: Pilots who flew last month but not this month (lapsed)
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 182. Per UTC month of flight completion: pilots with a Y-suffixed name who flew that month (pilots_current_month), how many of the previous month's pilots did not fly this month (lapsed), and that as a percentage of the previous month's pilots. v1 quirk kept: 'previous month' is the previous row, so a month with no flights is skipped. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table (see docs/t15_notes/a_pilots_people.md): one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
),
monthly_pilots AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
    cid
  FROM flight_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
  AND completion_time IS NOT NULL
  AND name IS NOT NULL
  AND LENGTH(name) >= 4
  AND SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), cid
),
monthly_comparison AS (
  SELECT
    m1.month as current_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m1.cid) as pilots_current_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m2.cid IS NULL THEN m1.cid END) as pilots_who_lapsed_next_month
  FROM monthly_pilots m1
  LEFT JOIN monthly_pilots m2 ON m1.cid = m2.cid
    AND m2.month = m1.month + INTERVAL '1 month'
  GROUP BY m1.month
),
retention_data AS (
  SELECT
    c.current_month,
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(c.current_month, 'FMMonth YYYY')) as month_label,
    c.pilots_current_month,
    c.pilots_who_lapsed_next_month,
    LAG(c.pilots_current_month) OVER (ORDER BY c.current_month) as previous_month_pilots,
    LAG(c.pilots_who_lapsed_next_month) OVER (ORDER BY c.current_month) as lapsed_from_previous_month
  FROM monthly_comparison c
)
SELECT
  current_month,
  month_label,
  pilots_current_month,
  lapsed_from_previous_month as lapsed,
  CASE
    WHEN lapsed_from_previous_month IS NOT NULL AND previous_month_pilots IS NOT NULL
    THEN ROUND(lapsed_from_previous_month * 100.0 / previous_month_pilots, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END as percentage_lapsed,
  CASE
    WHEN previous_month_pilots IS NOT NULL
    THEN CONCAT(month_label, ' - ', pilots_current_month, ' pilots, ', lapsed_from_previous_month, ' lapsed from ', TRIM(TO_CHAR(current_month - INTERVAL '1 month', 'Mon')))
    ELSE CONCAT(month_label, ' - ', pilots_current_month, ' pilots')
  END as retention_summary
FROM retention_data
ORDER BY current_month
